issues.where: UnitDotSwarmRegroupV2.tsx DIGIT_PTS / ONE..SEVEN bitmaps, final frames f130-149
issues.problem: Final dot-matrix number is not legible as ۱۲٬۸۴۷. The hand-drawn 5x7 Persian forms read as odd glyphs: ۱ has a hook like ٦, ۲ looks like ٣, ۴ is a blob, ۸ is a hollow arch. The original 12,847 is clearly readable and this is the payoff frame of the demo.
issues.suggestedFix: Rasterize the real Vazirmatn digit glyphs (offscreen canvas at ~280px) and sample cell centres to build the dot bitmaps at a higher resolution (e.g. 7x9 or 9x11 with SUB 1x1), keeping about 320 points. Check the f149 still until every digit is unmistakable. Alternatively use simplified stroke-based digits: ۱ vertical bar with small flag, ۲ curved hook plus base stroke, ۴ with the closed triangle head, ۸ inverted V, ۷ V.

issues.problem: Bar stack fill order inside each column is not mirrored. The incomplete top row still starts at the left, as in the original. Under RTL, filling should start at the right and the partial row should sit on the right.
issues.suggestedFix: Use col = 7 - (j % 8) in bar(). This only changes which cell each dot takes, not timing or seeds.

issues.problem: The spike is now born at the left edge directly under the readout and its peak (y~425) touches the 'درخواست/ثانیه · زنده' label, which grows with the 1.32 scale pop. In the original the spike peak passed beside the label. Looks cramped at the hit.
issues.suggestedFix: Shorten or lower the readout label, or nudge the readout block up or raise PLOT_Y a little, so there is at least about 12px of clearance at the spike peak and at readScale 1.32.

issues.problem: '۶۰ث پیش' uses the abbreviation ث, which is not idiomatic in a polished UI and sits tight against the digits. The numeral and the Persian unit also collapse visually.
issues.suggestedFix: Use '۶۰ ثانیه پیش' (140px wide boxes fit at fs(17)), or use '۶۰- ث' style only if intended. Keep «اکنون».

issues.problem: Free cluster label «رایگان · ۷٬۲۱۰» is touched by a stray dot at about (1447,455). Not new (same in the original), but now more visible against the heavier Persian label.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally raise the label offset (CLUSTER_R + 66 to about +80) for the Free group only.

notes: Everything else checks out: Axis and Oscilloscope comps mirror correctly (time axis, value axis on the right, tag origin, header), Persian shaping and digits fine, no leftover Latin or Chinese except the isolated API, letterSpacing is 0, timings and constants match the originals. The main blocker is dot-matrix digit legibility.
